create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting an attribute on a Runner or Reducer class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor with no type enforcement to freely manage attribute access on a class
review_ManagedAttribute_set_name: review the ManagedAttribute __set_name__ method that maps a public attribute name to its private underscore-prefixed storage name
review_ManagedAttribute_get_set: review the ManagedAttribute __get__ and __set__ descriptor methods that handle attribute retrieval and type-checked assignment
refactor_ManagedAttribute_type_check: refactor the ManagedAttribute __set__ method to support multiple allowed types instead of a single enforced type
